beats.line: My Gym Jarvis checked twenty-three sets, and called stop on a good one.
So let's open my Workout Analyser.
After over 200 papers and tools, I realized counting reps is easy, but judging one is hard.
So I built one pose tool and two agents.
It tracks my joints, and rep maths turns each rep into a wave.
A taller wave means I moved further, so cut-short reps look shorter.
And like a trainer, it compares each wave with my own best.
The first agent is the judge, which reads my numbers.
The second agent is the coach, a second opinion that isn't allowed the numbers.
And one guardrail before any AI: if the code can't see the joint, it won't judge.
Then I ran every set, and most were continue or hold.
Except this one, where the judge said stop and the coach said good.
I had only turned towards the camera, like the research warned.
So now, stop needs both agents to agree, or I check the footage.
And only one stop survived, my reverse crunch, which was fair.
Next up: Salesforce is reportedly letting people go, but hiring people with AI experience.
How can you be that one? Follow along to know.

changes: The fact notes are numbered for a 19-beat version, so I mapped them by content: note 8 -> beat 6, note 12 -> beat 10, note 13 -> beat 11, note 18 -> beat 16.
Beat 6: 'tired reps' -> 'cut-short reps'. The system measures range, not fatigue.

Beat 10: 'if it can't see the joint, it won't judge' -> 'before any AI: if the code can't see the joint, it won't judge'. The refusal is a code check that runs before either agent, not the coach's decision.

Beat 11: unchanged. Note 13 targeted an older wording ('six continue, eleven hold, two stop'). The current line is true: all 23 sets were run, and 17 of 23 final verdicts are continue (6) or hold (11).

Beat 16: unchanged as instructed (same tease as the main reel), so the note asking for 'AI engineers with post-training experience' is not applied. The on-screen source tag 'People Matters, DNA · 19-20 Nov 2026 · not confirmed by Salesforce' is still needed.
Beat 17 and all other beats: unchanged.
